# Phase 05.1 — Correctness Hardening

Scope source: improvements **#1**, **#2**, and **#12** in
[../improvements.md](../improvements.md).

This phase fixes small, high-impact correctness gaps that affect CodeBuddy's
own repo and any real-world repo with mixed markdown and ESM-style imports.

## Goals

- make the architecture map resolve local `.js`/`.jsx` specifiers to source
  files correctly;
- make plan discovery tolerant of non-plan markdown in `.codebuddy/plans/`;
- remove or document repo-local layout footguns exposed by the current repo.

## Build targets

1. Update the map import resolver so `import "./x.js"` and `import "./x.jsx"`
   can resolve to sibling TypeScript/JavaScript source the same way
   extensionless imports already do.
2. Add focused tests for `.js` specifier resolution in the architecture map and
   any downstream query helpers that depend on those edges.
3. Change `PlanFileStore.listPlans()` so it does not throw on arbitrary markdown
   files in `.codebuddy/plans/`.
4. Choose one tolerance strategy and apply it consistently:
   - preferred: only parse `pln_*.md`;
   - acceptable: skip invalid files with an explainable warning path.
5. Add tests covering mixed directories: valid plans, hand-written notes, and
   malformed markdown.
6. Resolve improvement **#12** in one of two ways:
   - move repo design docs out of `.codebuddy/plans/`; or
   - keep them there only if target #3 fully makes the tool tolerant.

## Non-goals

- redesigning the plan format;
- adding new plan commands;
- broad architecture-map parser work beyond the `.js`/`.jsx` resolution bug;
- roadmap work such as symbol-level slicing.

## Verification checklist

- architecture map tests prove `.js` imports produce edges in this repo style;
- `plan list` and context flows no longer fail when non-plan markdown exists;
- no existing CLI or MCP schema changes unless strictly necessary;
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm test`

## Execution prompt

You are a senior software developer implementing Phase 05.1 for CodeBuddy.
Work only from the scoped improvement items above. First inspect the current
map resolver and `PlanFileStore` behavior, then implement the smallest durable
fixes with tests. Prefer deterministic behavior over permissive magic. If you
choose to skip invalid plan files instead of filtering by filename, make the
behavior explicit and bounded. Finish by running the full verification checklist
and summarizing exactly which improvement items are now closed.
